title: Google Ads Agent Client Config
description: Validates client.config.json — the single per-client file that drives the config-driven Google Ads search agent. Zero per-client code lives in the shared engine; everything client-specific lives here. Secrets are NEVER stored here: auth is supplied via environment-variable NAMES only (see .env.example). Faithful to the shared google-ads-search-manager engine's GoogleAdsClientConfig, with keyword seeds and campaign-bootstrap knobs consolidated in so the whole intake is one file.

acceptance.description: Verification-first completion criteria derived from the task brief / one-shot intake. Criteria here are the durable source of truth for what must PASS (script-verifiable) or PARK (human gate) before the agent can claim done.

goalCondition.description: Paste-ready Claude Code /goal condition for this client, e.g. require verify/engine-load to exit 0 and every configured Google Ads criterion to be PASS or PARKED with evidence.

verification.description: How this criterion is checked: command, artifact path, validateOnly preflight, or named human gate.

gate.description: Optional human gate owner/name when the criterion cannot be fully machine-checked.

verifier.description: Who decides this criterion. code = a registered check in scripts/verify-acceptance.registry.mjs keyed by this id, graded against a runs/<client>/<stamp>/ artifact dir; external = a third-party service's verdict (here: the Google Ads API itself) read by a registered check; human = PARKED at the named gate, never self-graded by the agent that produced the artifact. Omitted: gate present => human, else code.

negativeCase.description: The fixture or scenario where this check correctly FAILS. A check that cannot be made to fail is not a check. Every code/external criterion in this vertical has one in template/google-ads-agent/fixtures/runs-bad/ (see test/acceptance.test.mjs); unregistered ids fail closed either way.

params.description: Thresholds and knobs the registered check reads. The check decides HOW, params say HOW MUCH — e.g. winners-conform reads {"tolerance": 1.0} as a multiplier on thresholds.target_cpa; cost-arithmetic reads {"tolerance": 0.01, "relativeTolerance": 0.01} as the reconciliation envelope.

maxAttempts.description: Bound on the fix->rerun-verify goal loop. Exhausting it is a legitimate terminal FAIL: report with evidence, never round up to done.

client_key.description: Slug identifying the client. MUST equal the scaffold --slug and the config filename stem. The shared engine selects a client with --client <client_key> / GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT.

display_name.description: Human-readable client / brand name, used in run logs.

google_ads.description: The Google Ads accounts this agent operates on. IDs live here (not secret); auth lives in env NAMES only.

customer_id.description: The client Google Ads account being managed (the customer id). Digits, dashes allowed and stripped at runtime. Copied into env GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID by the engine.

login_customer_id.description: The MCC / manager account used as the login-customer-id header. Graphed's MCC is 5538233519. Copied into env GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID by the engine.

campaigns.description: The Testing (broad-match discovery) and Winners (exact-match proven) campaigns. NAMES are operator-chosen and set at intake; the three *_id fields are placeholders until `bootstrap` creates the PAUSED campaigns and writes the real numeric ids back here (assertCampaignsBootstrapped refuses the daily loop until they are numeric).

testing_campaign_name.description: Name of the broad-match discovery campaign. Used in GAQL WHERE campaign.name filters. Convention: graphed_testing.

winners_campaign_name.description: Name of the exact-match Winners campaign (one EXACT ad group per proven winner). Convention: graphed_winners.

testing_campaign_id.description: Numeric id of the Testing campaign. Placeholder until bootstrap writes it back.

testing_ad_group_id.description: Numeric id of the seed ad group inside Testing where seed keywords are added. Placeholder until bootstrap writes it back.

winners_campaign_id.description: Numeric id of the Winners campaign. Placeholder until bootstrap writes it back.

thresholds.description: The operator knobs that drive the daily Testing→Winners loop.

target_cpa.description: Max cost-per-conversion (currency units) for a converting search term to count as a Winner. A term is promoted only if conversions > 0 AND costPerConversion <= target_cpa.

waste_min_spend.description: Min spend (currency units) at zero conversions before a search term is flagged waste and negative-matched.

lookback_days.description: GAQL lookback window (DURING LAST_<n>_DAYS) for winners, waste, and prune.

prune_min_spend.description: Winners-prune spend floor (currency units): never negate a served term below this spend (default 10). Mirrors waste_min_spend — the missing floor on the prune side is what strangled Conduit's delivery (FDE-303).

prune_require_zero_conversions.description: Never negate a served term that converted in the lookback (default true). THE guard that would have prevented the Conduit incident: negatives are subtractive filters, and negating converters kills working traffic.

max_negatives_per_run.description: Blast-radius cap: at most this many new negatives per prune run (default 25), highest demonstrated waste first; the excess is reported as SKIP CAPPED in prune.json, never silently dropped.

prune_hard_cpa_cap.description: Optional (null/absent = off): a CONVERTING term becomes negation-eligible again when its cost/conversion exceeds this absolute cap — the 7/14 runaway-spend guard translated to Google's mechanism. Leave off until Cody rules on the FB→Google mapping (FDE-303 Q3).

hard_cpa_cap.description: Performance-prune: CPA above this cap marks a winner ad group for pruning (engine default 100).

min_age_hours.description: Performance-prune: minimum ad-group age before judging (engine default 36).

min_spend_to_judge.description: Performance-prune: minimum spend before judging (engine default 35).

zero_conv_kill_multiple.description: Performance-prune: zero-conversion kill multiple vs target (engine default 1.5).

max_prunes_per_run.description: Performance-prune: cap on prunes per run (engine default 15).

promotion.description: The Responsive Search Ad (RSA) content used when a Winner is promoted into its exact-match ad group.

landing_page_url.description: Final URL for the RSA created when promoting a winner.

brand_headline.description: Brand headline woven into the RSA (headline 3).

descriptions.description: RSA description lines (at least 2, Google requires 2+).

safety.description: The write-safety posture. The engine's every mutation flows through one mutate(ops, validateOnly) call; these set its defaults. Campaigns are always created PAUSED regardless.

default_validate_only.description: When true, writes default to Google Ads validateOnly (dry-run) mode unless an explicit --apply / --auto-apply flag is passed. MUST be true in the template default.

require_apply_flag.description: Records the intent that real writes require an explicit --apply flag. The actual gate is the presence of the flag; this documents the policy.

seeds.description: The keyword seed set the agent adds to the Testing seed ad group on `seed`. Emitted by the scaffolder to seeds.json alongside the config.

broad.description: Positive keywords added to the Testing seed ad group as BROAD match (broad self-expands for discovery).

phrase.description: Positive keywords added as PHRASE match. Optional.

negatives.description: Brand-safety BROAD campaign-level negatives on the Testing campaign. Optional.

bootstrap.description: Knobs used ONCE, when bootstrap creates the PAUSED Testing + Winners campaigns. Not read by the daily loop.

daily_budget.description: Daily budget (account currency) applied to BOTH the Testing and Winners campaign budgets at creation.

dashboard.description: Optional dashboard branding. report.ts embeds these tokens into dashboard/data.json; the static dashboard/index.html applies them as CSS variables. Colors default to the fleet-neutral clean white/black monochrome (#1a1a1a / #4a4a4a on white) when omitted.

title.description: Dashboard page title. Defaults to '<display_name> Google Ads'.

initials.description: Logo-badge initials. Defaults to the first letters of display_name.

primary.description: Primary brand color (hex): headings, logo badge, stat values.

biddingStrategy.description: Campaign bidding strategy set at bootstrap. MAXIMIZE_CLICKS is the safe default (does not require conversion tracking to exist yet); switch to MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS once the account has conversion history.
